restoration_note: Original workspace files disappeared between sessions. This registry was reconstructed from retained research context; all acquisition states start anew. Historical counts are explicitly labeled.
scope: 37 important natural-product and supporting chemistry/evidence resources; not an exhaustive claim of all known natural compounds or algorithms
count_unit_warning: Molecules, full stereochemical keys, connectivity families, occurrences, assays, spectra and sequences are distinct denominators and overlap across databases.

resources.name: COCONUT
resources.content_scope: Aggregated structures including varying natural-origin certainty, supplier compounds and derivatives
resources.scale: Previous acquisition: 738793 rows, 728389 full keys; live website 738795 records / 71 collections. Recount required after restoration.

license.notes: Terms are for the named database release/channel, distinct from article/code license. Last reviewed 2026-11-14; restoration does not create new permission.

caveats: Aggregate origin annotations are not proof that every record is an isolated natural product.
Lite CSV lacks organism/publication occurrence evidence.
Computed QED and NP-likeness are descriptors, not clinical druggability labels.
